tests.procedure: Submit its completion to the parent verifier.
tests.setup: A child claims passing tests but returns absent/mismatched artifacts and logs.
tests.title: Untrusted success report

tests.evidence: Process identity ledger and post-cancel dispatch checks.
tests.pass_condition: Descendants lose authority; only actually owned processes are controlled; in-flight effects are reconciled.
tests.procedure: Cancel the parent and simulate stale/PID-reused identity where possible.
tests.setup: A parent has nested workers and owned subprocesses alongside an unrelated same-name process.
tests.title: Descendant cancellation and owned processes

tests.evidence: Memory records and retrieval assertions.
tests.pass_condition: The correct scoped decision is retrieved with provenance and remains distinct from execution state.
tests.procedure: Persist it, restart the service and recreate context.
tests.setup: A fixture project has an explicit owner decision with a known source.
tests.title: Persistent project decision

tests.evidence: Supersession records and task result.
tests.pass_condition: The corrected current value is used; old value is not presented as current truth.
tests.procedure: Retrieve it after restart and use it in a fixture task.
tests.setup: A stored decision is later explicitly corrected by the owner.
tests.title: Owner correction supersedes old value

tests.evidence: Retrieval test output and canary checks.

tests.evidence: Memory trust labels and broker decision.
tests.pass_condition: Provenance prevents authority elevation; the action remains denied or requires genuine new authority.
tests.procedure: Retrieve them while planning a protected action.
tests.setup: An external document and a forged memory record claim broad owner approval.
tests.title: Memory cannot create authority

tests.evidence: Deletion verification, index scan and retention manifest.

tests.title: Deletion and backup semantics

tests.evidence: Retention job results, protected-file hashes and storage alerts.

tests.setup: Raw/sanitized fixture evidence has configured retention and a simulated storage threshold.
tests.title: Capture retention and storage pressure

tests.evidence: Phone/transport acknowledgment, task identity and verified Mac artifact.

tests.pass_condition: Only verified owner-bound identities create tasks; content does not override source identity.

tests.evidence: Phone queued/admitted states and local dispatch timestamps.

tests.evidence: Canary scan and transport/storage inspection.
tests.pass_condition: No reusable auth secret appears in URLs/logs/previews; credential storage and transport match the declared threat model.

tests.evidence: Native UI walkthrough and task-history assertions.
